name: Oban
method: tidetimes.org.uk Oban vs its own Tobermory (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Tobermory: median time difference, least-squares height fit
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Oban vs Tobermory, 2025-10-01 to 2026-10-28 (every 1 day(s), 1483 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
note: Height = offset + scale * Tobermory: Oban's range is ~16% smaller. Half of events land within 5-6 min of the reference; time offset has no useful link to spring/neap, season or diurnal inequality. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
